name: order_flow_imbalance_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional algorithms are working large directional orders via TWAP/VWAP execution, each 5-second bar exhibits a measurable volume tilt: heavier volume on uptick bars (close > open) than downtick bars during accumulation, and the reverse during distribution. Cumulating this volume-weighted bar_delta (volume × sign(close − open)) over a 1-minute window and z-scoring it against a 5-minute rolling baseline captures abnormal buy/sell pressure before it fully manifests in price. When this z-score exceeds ±1.5 and price confirms direction relative to session VWAP, the unexecuted tail of the institutional order typically pushes NIFTY a further 10-20 spot points within 30-90 seconds — unlike the unweighted direction proxy, high-volume bars carry proportionally more signal weight, making the z-score more sensitive to genuine institutional size rather than routine tick noise.

indicators.name: bar_delta
indicators.purpose: Volume-weighted per-bar delta: positive on uptick bars (close > open), negative on downtick bars, scaled by actual volume. Unlike unweighted direction, a 10,000-lot uptick bar contributes 100x more than a 100-lot doji, better reflecting genuine institutional size. This is the key differentiator from the unweighted signed-direction approach.

indicators.name: cum_delta_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute (12 × 5s) cumulative volume delta — the trigger-level imbalance accumulation window. NOT 10×12=120 bars. Original used 10-min cumulative for a 5-15 min hold; we hold 15-90s so 1-minute is the right window: long enough to filter individual-bar noise, short enough to remain predictive for a sub-2-minute hold.

indicators.name: delta_zscore
indicators.purpose: Normalize 1-min cumulative delta against a 5-minute (60 × 5s) rolling window. Original normalized over 60-min bars (60 minutes). Compressed to 5 min because NIFTY intraday vol regimes shift session-to-session — morning gap dynamics differ from afternoon drift; 5-min context captures the current regime without diluting with stale pre-noon data during afternoon entries.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(close * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP from 09:15, reset each day. Directional filter: buy CE only above VWAP, buy PE only below VWAP. Eliminates counter-trend imbalance signals that are likely noise rather than the start of a sustained institutional flow. Identical to the original strategy's VWAP alignment filter.

conditions: delta_zscore > 1.5 — 1-min volume-weighted buy imbalance is 1.5 std above recent norm
close > vwap — price confirming bullish regime relative to session benchmark
delta_zscore < -1.5 — 1-min volume-weighted sell imbalance is 1.5 std below recent norm
close < vwap — price confirming bearish regime relative to session benchmark

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If confirmed volume-delta imbalance reverses by 8 spot pts within 30s, the institutional order that drove the abnormal z-score has completed or been absorbed by opposing flow — the thesis is broken. Consistent with 15-second typical NIFTY option move of 1-3 pts; stop triggers after approximately 2 adverse bars.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts). Institutional TWAP slices on NIFTY typically push 15-25 spot pts per burst before pause; 14 pts captures ~60-70% of the lower-bound expectation at a 1:1.75 R:R. Even at a 56% win rate (the original equity backtest estimate), this R:R is strongly profitable after costs.

filters.vix_filter: none — volume-weighted delta works across vol regimes; the z-score normalization self-adjusts to current session volatility
filters.time_filter: no trades first 10 min (09:15-09:25 IST) to skip pre-open auction volume noise; no new entries after 15:20
filters.volume_filter: implicit — bar_delta is zero on zero-volume bars, so halts/gaps auto-excluded
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment: buy CE only above VWAP, buy PE only below VWAP
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — volume delta on 5s OHLCV bars is a noisy proxy for true tick-level order flow; signal is most reliable during high-volume institutional TWAP windows (10:00-11:30, 13:30-15:00 IST)

adaptation_notes: Original traded Nifty50 constituent stocks (top 20 by turnover) at 1-min bars with 10-min cumulative volume delta and 60-min z-score normalization. Changes: (1) universe collapsed to NIFTY index directly — aggregate constituent volume on the index captures the same institutional flow that drives individual stock deltas; (2) cumulative window compressed 10 min → 1 min (12 bars) matching the shorter hold time; (3) normalization window compressed 60 min → 5 min (60 bars) to track current session vol regime; (4) z-score threshold lowered from 2.0 to 1.5 because 5s bars are noisier and need a lower threshold to fire with sufficient frequency; (5) VWAP filter retained unchanged; (6) volume-weighting preserved — this is the key differentiator vs unweighted direction strategies.
weaknesses: bar_delta using close vs open misclassifies doji bars (close ≈ open with high activity) — these score near-zero delta even if two-sided institutional activity was high
NIFTY index volume aggregates all constituent trades; high-volume downtick on one component can cancel a high-volume uptick on another, producing misleading delta
Z-score normalization breaks during very-low-volume periods (lunch lull 12:30-13:00) where rolling STDDEV collapses toward zero
